info.title: PERK API
info.description: PERK private beta: MFA, secure stores and resumable read-only WB imports.

get.description: Process is running. Does not depend on PostgreSQL or Redis.
Check database and broker connections; does not check workers or migration versions.

post.description: Always answers the same way; the account is created only after the emailed code.
Password step. The returned session is limited until /auth/mfa/verify succeeds.
Replaces the limited session with a new fully verified one.

Revoking every device needs a verified session: a password alone must not lock out
the owner. A limited session can still end itself via /auth/logout.
Same answer for unknown addresses. A reset never bypasses the phone/app factor.

get.description: Read the stored WB balance. No provider calls on the request path.

Returns a financial snapshot from stored daily aggregates. During an active import, available preview days are returned with ready and is_partial=true, preserving published days outside the preview. Each day comes from one source only. Failed imports fall back to the previous successful report. While preparing a newer projection, the previous projection remains readable with period_covered=false. No WB requests or raw-import rebuilds are performed by this read.
Profit before tax, VAT, tax estimate and net profit. Default: last 30 days.
Per-unit economics for every SKU, worst total profit first. Default: last 30 days.
Days of cover per SKU, most urgent first. Served from a precomputed snapshot.

post.description: Quantity per SKU, split by warehouse demand and size. Instant: uses the forecast snapshot.

get.description: First screen in one request: sales, profit, stock alerts and top money findings.
Where the store loses money: penalties, storage, loss-making SKUs, stockouts.
Orders, cancellations, buyouts and the buyout rate by day and by SKU (last 90 days).

Buyouts by sale date for any period since 2024-01-29.

Recent days come from the sales report, older ones from financial reports.
Complete period totals and comparison, independent of daily chart loading.
Marketplace funnel and order-date cohorts; unavailable metrics remain unknown.
Returns to the seller by type, status and SKU, plus items waiting at pickup points.
Monthly demand index from at least a year of the store's own report history.
Journal for chart annotations. Store-wide events are included for every SKU.
Plan/fact for a month: actual to yesterday and a linear forecast to month end.
One store or the whole business; no WB calls. RLS limits every store and report read.
Stored finance groups, both revenue bases, expenses and estimated taxes.
Newest first; page with `before` = created_at of the last item.
